core_obligations: Reduction to an inclusion (proof lines 10486-10499): by the companion result the pushforward along a closed immersion is isomorphic to the inclusion of the full subcategory of sheaves annihilated by the pullback of the localization in a subsheaf of the final object.

Commutation with colimits (proof lines 10502-10507): for two morphisms of that subcategory the coequalizer and the pushout lie in the subcategory because the relevant pullback is exact and the objects are annihilated; hence the inclusion commutes with them.

Conclusion (proof lines 10510-10513): the inclusion therefore satisfies the properties of the companion list which concern colimits, and the companion equivalence then yields all the listed properties.
proof_roadmap: Identify the pushforward with the inclusion of a full subcategory.
Check commutation with coequalizers and pushouts inside that subcategory.
Invoke the companion equivalence to obtain all the listed properties.
difficulty_reason: The lemma lists exactness properties of the pushforward along a closed immersion of topoi: full faithfulness, preservation of surjections, commutation with coequalizers and pushouts and reflection of injections, surjections and bijections (statement lines 10477-10483). The proof is a complete reduction: the companion result identifies the pushforward with the inclusion of the full subcategory of sheaves annihilated by the pullback of the localization (proof lines 10486-10499); the coequalizers and pushouts of morphisms in that subcategory stay inside it because the pullback is exact (proof lines 10502-10507); and the companion equivalence of exactness properties then yields everything listed (proof lines 10510-10513). The non-formal content is the reduction to the inclusion and the two commutation checks. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with each input named.
